_readme: EDITORIAL RULINGS THAT OVERRIDE THE POWO EXPORT.
House rule, stated 2026-08-31: a published journal article trumps POWO.
The POWO export is the base list, not the verdict. Where Aroidpedia has
decided otherwise, the decision lives here and the extractor applies it.
exclude  a name POWO accepts that we do not. Dropped from the data.
include  a name POWO has dropped (or never carried) that we keep.
Needs a year, because it is not coming from the export.
Every entry carries a reason. `source` is the citation that settles it —
fill it in when the paper is to hand; `authority` records whose ruling it
is in the meantime. An entry with neither is a note to self, not a fact.
Consumed by scripts/extract-species-years.py, which prints every ruling
it applied and FAILS if one no longer matches (see below), so a ruling
cannot quietly rot after POWO catches up.

exclude.name: Alocasia augustiana
exclude.reason: Invalid; = Alocasia aequiloba. POWO/Kew recognise it, Aroidpedia does not.

include.name: Alocasia okinawensis
include.reason: Valid. POWO no longer lists it; the published treatment stands.

include.name: Alocasia rivularis
include.reason: Valid. POWO no longer lists it; the published treatment stands.

include.name: Alocasia lihengiae
include.reason: Valid. POWO no longer lists it; the published treatment stands.
